risk_note: RV2 migration (withdraw lane B2-06a; model Claude Fable 5.1). Four new payout tables: app.payout_batches (kind manual / auto, created_by only for manual), app.payout_batch_items (insert-only member outcomes paying / skipped / blocked / moved_out with consistency CHECKs, reject_update_delete trigger), app.payout_attempts (one row per channel call; the only UPDATE completes a pending row once — trigger payout_attempts_complete_once limits columns and refuses DELETE; 04 §3.2「只插入」read as append-only, reported to the orchestrator), app.payout_watermarks (insert-only finance entries of W per channel, D10-223). withdrawals.batch_id foreign key added NOT VALID (0094) and validated by its own migration (0095; funds table, no squawk exception, precedent 0071 / 0072). Column-level grants: couli_app SELECT, INSERT on batches / items / watermarks and SELECT on attempts; couli_payout SELECT on all, INSERT on attempts, UPDATE only of the completion columns; couli_readonly SELECT; nobody deletes. Generated db/schema.sql and packages/db/src/db.gen.ts from the test machine's db:snapshot. tools/ci/lint-migrations.test.ts lock list gains the four tables (additions only). 40 rule tests (39 in round 1, [AC-B2-06a#40] added under D10-237) (test/spec/db/payout/core-*.int.test.ts, Codex round 1) red at the spec commit on the test machine. Codex hit its usage limit on 2026-10-23 10:2x; later rounds and reviews are by independent Claude (engine claude-independent). D10-237: payout_attempts_transfer_once_key (withdrawal_id) WHERE kind='transfer' enforces one transfer attempt per withdrawal; D10-241: no measured_at CHECK against created_at. Handover (orchestrator 2026-10-26 19:4x): original author withdraw lane (account 4, paused to 10-30; spec affc5c23 / e99ca481, implementation head 2e8042f9 with placeholder 0081 / 0082, 10-23 verify/2 exit 0); taken over by admin-backend, which rebuilt the branch on main 9ec0bd03 (both spec commits cherry-picked unchanged, the implementation as one commit carrying 2e8042f9's final migration text), renumbered the migrations to 0094 / 0095 (main's highest + 1 / + 2), merged the lint-migrations list with main's, re-ran db:snapshot, the red run and the full verification on the test machine. Reviews were not re-run: the migration text is byte-identical to the reviewed one apart from the file names.
